plan.title: Assign technical evaluator to line item

steps.note: Start a multi-stage event creation flow.
Create the Technical Stage needed for line-item evaluator assignment.
Work on the technical stage where the line-item evaluator control exists.
Apply the first available technical template before configuring its questions and line items.
Create the first line item whose technical section should receive an evaluator.
Populate the technical questionnaire sections so the evaluator controls are configured.
Assign an available organization user to the technical evaluator control for the line item.
Confirm the assignment flow completed without an application error.
